title: Year 1996
summary: EVEREADY® introduces Energizer® e2®, the first AA lithium battery. 1992 EVEREADY® introduces the company’s first LED lights, offering a squeeze light, compact area/directional light. 1996 EVEREADY® celebrates 100 years of portable lighting product leadership. 1998

EVEREADY® introduces Energizer® e2®, the first AA lithium battery.

1996
